Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly analyzed the flow of thermal energy in the scenario. Thermal energy always flows from a higher temperature object to a lower temperature object. In this case, the hot tea (higher temperature) transfers thermal energy to the ice (lower temperature), not the other way around. The Planner mistakenly concluded that energy flows from the ice to the tea, leading to the wrong final answer (A) instead of the correct answer (B).
